name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: golang:1.27
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [amd64, arm64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: go vet ./...
      - run: GOARCH=${{ matrix.arch }} go test ./...
  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref_name == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: alpine:3.22
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/deploy.sh
        env:
          TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

stages:
  - stage-0
  - stage-1
workflow:
  name: ci
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME == "main"
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"
# pipemaster:emulated job.if pipeline/ci/job/deploy

  stage: stage-1
  image: alpine:3.22
  needs:
    - test
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE !~ /^merge_request_event$/i && $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME =~ /^main$/i
  script:
    # pipemaster:step deploy-step-1
    # pipemaster:step deploy-step-2
    # pipemaster:emulated step.env pipeline/ci/job/deploy/step/deploy-step-2
    - |
      (
      export TOKEN="$DEPLOY_TOKEN"
      ./scripts/deploy.sh
      )
  environment: production
test:
  stage: stage-0
  image: golang:1.27
  needs: []
  script:
    # pipemaster:step test-step-1
    # pipemaster:step test-step-2
    - go vet ./...
    # pipemaster:step test-step-3
    - GOARCH=$arch go test ./...
  parallel:
    matrix:
      - arch:
          - amd64
          - arm64

    - name: ctx-repo

        - name: ctx-repo
          value: $(params.ctx-repo)
        - name: ctx-sha
          value: $(params.ctx-sha)
      matrix:
        params:
          - name: arch
            value:

              - arm64

apiVersion: triggers.tekton.dev/v1beta1
kind: EventListener
metadata:
  name: pipemaster
spec:
  serviceAccountName: pipemaster-triggers
  triggers:
    - name: ci-pr-0
      interceptors:
        - ref:
            name: github
          params:
            - name: eventTypes
              value:
                - pull_request
            - name: secretRef
              value:
                secretName: pipemaster-github-webhook
                secretKey: token
        - ref:
            name: cel
          params:
            - name: filter
              value: body.action in ['opened','synchronize','reopened'] && body.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == body.repository.full_name && (body.pull_request.base.ref.matches(r'^main$'))
            - name: overlays
              value:
                - key: ctx_sha
                  expression: body.pull_request.head.sha
                - key: ctx_repo
                  expression: body.repository.full_name
                - key: ctx_ref_name
                  expression: string(int(body.number)) + '/merge'
      bindings:
        - ref: ci-github
      template:
        ref: ci-run
    - name: ci-push-1
      interceptors:
        - ref:
            name: github
          params:
            - name: eventTypes
              value:
                - push
            - name: secretRef
              value:
                secretName: pipemaster-github-webhook
                secretKey: token
        - ref:
            name: cel
          params:
            - name: filter
              value: body.ref.startsWith('refs/heads/') && (body.ref.replace('refs/heads/','',1).matches(r'^main$'))
            - name: overlays
              value:
                - key: ctx_sha
                  expression: body.after
                - key: ctx_repo
                  expression: body.repository.full_name
                - key: ctx_ref_name
                  expression: body.ref.replace('refs/heads/','',1)
      bindings:
        - ref: ci-github
      template:
        ref: ci-run

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: EventSource
metadata:
  name: pipemaster-github
spec:
  github:
    pull_request:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - pull_request
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /pull_request
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
    push:
      active: true
      contentType: json
      events:
        - push
      repositories:
        - names:
            - REPO
          owner: OWNER
      webhook:
        endpoint: /push
        method: POST
        port: "12000"
        url: ""
      webhookSecret:
        key: token
        name: pipemaster-github-webhook
  service:
    ports:
      - port: 12000
        targetPort: 12000

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Sensor
metadata:
  name: pipemaster
spec:
  dependencies:
    - eventName: pull_request
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.action
            type: string
            value:
              - opened
              - reopened
              - synchronize
          - path: body.pull_request.base.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^main$
        exprs:
          - expr: head == base
            fields:
              - name: head
                path: body.pull_request.head.repo.full_name
              - name: base
                path: body.repository.full_name
      name: ci-pr
    - eventName: push
      eventSourceName: pipemaster-github
      filters:
        data:
          - path: body.ref
            type: string
            value:
              - ^refs/heads/main$
      name: ci-push
  template:
    serviceAccountName: pipemaster-sensor
  triggers:
    - template:
        conditions: ci-pr
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.sha
                dependencyName: ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: ci-pr
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.pull_request.head.ref
                dependencyName: ci-pr
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-name
                      value: ""
                serviceAccountName: pipemaster-workflow
                workflowTemplateRef:
                  name: ci
        name: ci-pr
    - template:
        conditions: ci-push
        k8s:
          operation: create
          parameters:
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.0.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.after
                dependencyName: ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.1.value
              src:
                dataKey: body.repository.full_name
                dependencyName: ci-push
            - dest: spec.arguments.parameters.2.value
              src:
                dataTemplate: '{{ trimPrefix "refs/heads/" .Input.body.ref }}'
                dependencyName: ci-push
          source:
            resource:
              apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
              kind: Workflow
              metadata:
                generateName: ci-
              spec:
                arguments:
                  parameters:
                    - name: ctx-sha
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-repo
                      value: ""
                    - name: ctx-ref-name
                      value: ""
                serviceAccountName: pipemaster-workflow
                workflowTemplateRef:
                  name: ci
        name: ci-push

apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowTemplate
metadata:
  name: ci
  annotations:
    workflows.argoproj.io/title: ci
spec:
  entrypoint: main
  arguments:
    parameters:
      - name: ctx-sha
        value: ""
      - name: ctx-repo
        value: ""
      - name: ctx-ref-name
        value: ""
  templates:
    - name: main
      dag:
        tasks:
          - name: deploy
            template: deploy
            dependencies:
              - test
            when: '{{= workflow.parameters[''ctx-ref-name''] == ''main'' }}'
          - name: test
            template: test
            withItems:
              - arch: amd64
              - arch: arm64
            arguments:
              parameters:
                - name: arch
                  value: '{{item.arch}}'
    - name: deploy
      containerSet:
        containers:
          - # pipemaster:id deploy-step-2
            name: main
            image: alpine:3.22
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
            args:
              - if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$1"
              - pipemaster
              - ./scripts/deploy.sh
            workingDir: /workspace
            env:
              - name: TOKEN
                valueFrom:
                  secretKeyRef:
                    name: ci-secrets
                    key: DEPLOY_TOKEN
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      inputs:
        artifacts:
          - name: source
            path: /workspace
            git:
              repo: https://github.com/{{workflow.parameters.ctx-repo}}.git
              revision: '{{workflow.parameters.ctx-sha}}'
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
          name: workspace
    - name: test
      containerSet:
        containers:
          - name: test-step-2
            image: golang:1.27
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
            args:
              - if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$1"
              - pipemaster
              - go vet ./...
            workingDir: /workspace
          - # pipemaster:id test-step-3
            name: main
            image: golang:1.27
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
            args:
              - if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$1"
              - pipemaster
              - GOARCH={{inputs.parameters.arch}} go test ./...
            workingDir: /workspace
            dependencies:
              - test-step-2
        volumeMounts:
          - name: workspace
            mountPath: /workspace
      inputs:
        parameters:
          - name: arch
        artifacts:
          - name: source
            path: /workspace
            git:
              repo: https://github.com/{{workflow.parameters.ctx-repo}}.git
              revision: '{{workflow.parameters.ctx-sha}}'
      volumes:
        - emptyDir: {}
          name: workspace

          inputs:

                if ! [ "$PM_CTX_BRANCH" = 'main' ]; then echo 'pipemaster: skipped: the condition of this step is false'; exit 0; fi # pipemaster:guard
                ./scripts/deploy.sh
            dir: workspace
  - name: test
    plan:
      - get: source
        trigger: true
      - do:
          - task: test-step-2
            input_mapping:
              workspace: source
            config:
              platform: linux
              image_resource:
                type: registry-image
                source:

                  tag: "1.27"
              inputs:
                - name: workspace
              outputs:
                - name: workspace
              run:
                path: sh

                  - -c
                  - if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$1"
                  - pipemaster
                  - go vet ./...
                dir: workspace
          - task: test-step-3
            config:

              image_resource:
                type: registry-image

                  repository: golang
                  tag: "1.27"
              inputs:
                - name: workspace
              outputs:
                - name: workspace
              params:
                PM_MATRIX_ARCH: ((.:arch))
              run:
                path: sh
                args:
                  - -c
                  - if command -v bash >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec bash -e -c "$1"; fi; exec sh -e -c "$1"
                  - pipemaster
                  - GOARCH=${PM_MATRIX_ARCH} go test ./...
                dir: workspace
        across:
          - var: arch
            values:
              - amd64
              - arm64
            max_in_flight: all
